title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker is wrongly imprisoned for murder and spends decades in prison, where he develops friendships, maintains hope, and quietly plans for freedom.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging head of a powerful crime family transfers control of his empire to his reluctant son, drawing him deeper into the world of organized crime.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces a dangerous criminal mastermind who creates chaos across Gotham City while forcing Batman, Commissioner Gordon, and Harvey Dent to confront difficult moral choices.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief who enters people's dreams is offered a chance to erase his criminal past by performing an almost impossible task: planting an idea inside someone's mind.

title: Interstellar
description: A former pilot joins a space mission through a mysterious wormhole to search for a habitable planet while humanity struggles to survive on a dying Earth.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer programmer discovers that the world he knows is an artificial reality created by machines and joins a rebellion to free humanity.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A kind and simple man unexpectedly becomes involved in major historical events while experiencing friendship, love, loss, and an extraordinary life journey.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit inherits a powerful ring and begins a dangerous journey with a fellowship of companions to prevent an ancient evil from returning.

title: Gladiator
description: A respected Roman general is betrayed and forced into slavery, eventually becoming a gladiator who seeks revenge against the corrupt emperor responsible for destroying his family.

title: The Prestige
description: Two rival magicians become obsessed with surpassing each other, leading them into a dangerous competition involving deception, sacrifice, secrets, and revenge.

title: Parasite
description: A struggling family gradually becomes involved with a wealthy household through a series of deceptions, exposing sharp divisions between social classes.

title: Whiplash
description: An ambitious young jazz drummer joins an elite music conservatory and faces an extremely demanding instructor who pushes him toward perfection through psychological pressure.

title: The Social Network
description: A young Harvard student creates a revolutionary social networking website, but its rapid growth leads to friendship conflicts, legal disputes, and questions about ownership.

title: The Wolf of Wall Street
description: A young stockbroker builds a wealthy and extravagant life through aggressive and fraudulent financial practices while his success attracts increasing attention from law enforcement.

title: The Green Mile
description: A prison officer develops an unusual relationship with a gentle inmate possessing mysterious abilities while confronting questions about justice, suffering, and compassion.

title: Fight Club
description: An unhappy office worker meets a charismatic stranger who introduces him to an underground fighting club that gradually develops into something much larger and more dangerous.

title: The Truman Show
description: A cheerful insurance salesman slowly realizes that his entire life is being secretly filmed for a television show and that everyone around him may be part of the production.

title: Good Will Hunting
description: A young man with extraordinary mathematical intelligence struggles with his troubled past and begins changing his life after forming a relationship with a therapist.

title: The Departed
description: An undercover police officer infiltrates a criminal organization while a corrupt informant secretly works inside the police department, creating a dangerous race to identify each other.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut is accidentally left behind on Mars and must use science, engineering, and determination to survive while NASA works to bring him home.
